title: Migrate audit-log ClickHouse cluster to ap-southeast-3 region
description: Moves the audit-log hot tier from ap-east-1 to ap-southeast-3 to reduce latency for downstream consumers in JKT. Requires synchronized cutover of all producers (billing-api, payments-svc, subscription-service, kyc-service) on the Kafka topic. The migration plan includes a 24h dual-write window. Per ADR-021 the hash chain must remain unbroken across the cutover — see INC-2025-09 for prior concerns.
diff:
diff --git a/audit-log/terraform/regions.tf
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
-provider "aws" { region = "ap-east-1" }
+provider "aws" { region = "ap-southeast-3" }

diff --git a/audit-log/src/clickhouse_client.py
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
-CLICKHOUSE_CLUSTER_ENDPOINT = os.environ['CH_ENDPOINT_AP_EAST_1']
+CLICKHOUSE_CLUSTER_ENDPOINT = os.environ['CH_ENDPOINT_AP_SOUTHEAST_3']

diff --git a/audit-log/migration/dual_write_window.md
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+# 24h dual-write window plan
+...
